question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No.5.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'concentration'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• problem - a matter or situation regarded as unwelcome or harmful and needing to be dealt with and overcome.
 
• concentration - the relative amount of a particular substance contained within a solution or mixture or in a particular volume of space.
 
• method - a particular procedure for accomplishing or approaching something, especially a systematic or established one.
 
• calculation - a mathematical determination of the amount or number of something.
 
 
 
• From the line with the blank, we can infer that **blank 5 **needs a word that would describe the presence of pollutants in the environment. 
 
• Hence, concentration is the most appropriate option for blank 5. 
 
• So, option 2 is the correct answer.

Correct paragraph__ - *Tree plantation is the (1)__process__ of transplanting saplings or seeds to maximise the amount of greenery and focus on promoting (2)__afforestation__. Planting trees can be a very rewarding and fruitful (3)__endeavour__! Not only is it (4)__ecologically__ beneficial for this planet, but it also contributes to helping create an environmentally friendly place to live, as trees help reduce pollutant (5)__concentration__.*
